name: agent-retro
description: A weekly retro of how you use AI coding agents (Codex, Claude Code, and optional ChatGPT or claude.ai exports): 12 animated slides of stats with four bite-sized, evidence-backed coaching tips.

interface.shortDescription: Your week with your coding agents
interface.longDescription: Reads your local Codex and Claude Code logs, plus ChatGPT or claude.ai exports in ~/Downloads, and builds an animated 12-slide deck: 8 fun stats about your week and 4 coaching tips, each backed by your own numbers. Everything runs on your machine.
defaultPrompt: Build my Agent Retro for this week
